golden_cases.question: 租户 1 在 2024-01 的 net_sales 是多少？
golden_cases.generated_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount - f.refund_amount)::numeric, 2) AS net_sales
FROM "chatbi_benchmark_v21".fact_sales f
WHERE f.order_status <> 'TEST'
  AND f.tenant_id = 1
  AND f.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND f.order_date < DATE '2024-02-01'
LIMIT 10
golden_cases.normalized_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.net_amount - f.refund_amount) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS net_sales FROM "chatbi_benchmark_v21".fact_sales AS f WHERE f.order_status <> 'TEST' AND f.tenant_id = 1 AND f.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND f.order_date < CAST('2024-02-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 10
